card.name: Words that can take an -ly ending
card.fires_on: Adjective-like words such as Recent, Indirect, Slight, Accidental, local and partial, where an adverb ending like -ly or -ally could follow. Seen in web page headings and in medical text.

card.plain: It fires on adjectives that could turn into adverbs with an -ly ending.
